capabilities: Evaluate expressions ending in = as you type, on ordinary note lines
Define variables and functions that carry down the note
Convert units and compute currency, percentages, and date differences
Write answers into the note individually or all at once
Optionally rewrite plain-English questions as calculations via Tahoe Intelligence
disambiguation: Not a LaTeX or math-notation renderer; it evaluates calculations typed at the end of plain text lines.
extras: Plain-English question answering requires the separate Tahoe Intelligence plugin and a Mac; the plugin itself works offline with no telemetry, accounts, or payments, and runs on mobile.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in calculator, so quick arithmetic in notes requires code blocks, special syntax, or leaving the app.

relations.evidence: Numerals and Tahoe Math both use math.js, and both work on phones and tablets.
Answers are worked out exactly by math.js, not guessed.
With the companion plugin Tahoe Intelligence (Mac only), you can also type questions

summary: Inline calculator that evaluates expressions ending in = on ordinary note lines, with variables, functions, units, currency, percentages and dates.
